broad_boundaries: All 21 activity/preparation disposition summaries and 26 native fact groups were read as source-author context; no blanket endorsement of their unresolved biochemical claims.

No whole-pathway organism assertion is transferred from individual enzymes. Native PDC-isolate ORG-5956 has no direct NCBI strain xref; species303 is a parent context, not an invented strain accession.
Source-native gene, monomer, complex, molecular activity, assay preparation and current reference sequence remain distinct entity levels.
